findings.effect: Original result is preserved and unaccepted. Numerical metadata agrees; that does not waive the interpreter contract.
findings.required_action: Correct the remote environment and run the separately authorized immutable successor under Python 3.12; never relabel or overwrite HY3-001.

findings.detail: All three HY3 artifact hashes match exact LF-to-CRLF reconstruction of pinned Git blobs. Canonical blob hashes differ and are recorded separately. Receipt identity, immutable task digest, actual parent, paths, manifest, commands and metadata match.

Chief stages scoped outputs before hashing binary git show :path stdout. Exact mixed CRLF/LF and trailing/absent newline bytes verify. Network retry delivers the unchanged committed fixture without recomputation and published-task deduplication holds.

Persistent Python version changes affect readiness fingerprint. updated_at, lease_until and ordinary ready/idle heartbeats do not; error-state transitions remain meaningful. Status publication includes the running interpreter on each update.
Real Python 3.12.14 CLI succeeds (exit 0). Mocked Python 3.13.14 CLI rejects (exit 1). This script enforces the environment when invoked; it does not by itself replace existing watcher processes.

Pinned historical optional log still fails receipt comparison, including uniform CRLF reconstruction. It is not reused, changed or certified. Mandatory accepted outputs match; fresh 28-test evidence replaces the excluded log.

An audit-only probe initially expected literal backslashes in the generated mixed-EOL fixture. AST byte inspection proved actual CRLF/LF. The audit assertion was corrected, retested, and the failed probe with exit 1 is retained in investigation.json. No production flaw was found.

limitations: This audit does not accept HY3-001 or execute the successor task.
The chief record reports 132 toy numerical checks; they were not rerun or presented as new Sol checks here.
Already-running remote watchers need an idle restart to load amended functions; this audit does not alter remote processes.
